subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in T(IMP)M-39 (The Teaching of Improvised Music, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues about 'applied definitions' — 'what a given definition used to mean in its source-initiation context, and what the same definition means after its adoption into the throngs of western dynamics. For every aspect of black methodology has had to necessarily be re-aligned to become real to western functionalism.' (C)PRI-INFO (principle information) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what principle-information produces when crossed with affinity-dynamics, in a culture where applied-definitions systematically realign black methodology to western functionalism. IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and INFO-DE-B (information degree basis) feed the upper-right. PER-DY (perception dynamics) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) are right-side outputs. LG-DY (logical dynamics) and APL-DY (applied dynamics) form the rightmost cluster. EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and POST (postulation) feed the lower-left. RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits), SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars), and ALT-F (alternative functionalism) form the lower convergence. Structural argument: principle-information crossed with affinity-dynamics requires the infra-structure-dynamics → information-degree-basis chain on the upper side, and the reality-initiative-traits → social-reality-particulars → alternative-functionalism chain on the lower side. Braxton's diagrammatic claim: only when both chains are operative does principle-information survive the realignment-to-western-functionalism that applied-definitions imposes.
